title: Upstream hold and release (router to agent, text frame)
description: Stops (hold) or starts again (release) the agent's OpenAI-compatible upstream to free or use the GPU (facts.upstream_release true, ADR-0033 to ADR-0037). The agent ignores a repeated order and reports the result in the OLLAMA frame (upstream_state, serving, upstream_blocked). The router sends it only to agents that announced upstream_release.
